{{Chelsea F.C. departments}}

'''Chelsea Football Club''' is a professional [[association football]] club based in [[Fulham]], West London, England. They compete in the [[Premier League]], the top tier of [[English football league system|English football]], and rank among the [[List of football clubs in England by competitive honours won|most successful clubs in English football history]]. Domestically, the club has secured six top flight league titles, eight [[FA Cup]]s, five [[EFL Cup|League Cup]]s, four [[FA Community Shield]]s, and two [[Full Members' Cup]]s. Internationally, their honours include two [[UEFA Champions League]]s, two [[UEFA Europa League]]s, two [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup]]s, two [[UEFA Super Cup]]s, two [[FIFA Club World Cup]]s, and one [[UEFA Conference League]].

The club was founded in 1905, taking its name from the adjacent area of [[Chelsea, London|Chelsea]], and plays its home matches at [[Stamford Bridge (stadium)|Stamford Bridge]]. Chelsea secured their first major trophy, the [[List of English football champions|First Division championship]], in [[1954–55 Football League|1955]], and won their first [[Premier League]] title in the [[2004–05 FA Premier League|2004–05 season]]. Their first European honour came in the [[1971 European Cup Winners' Cup final|1971]] [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup|Cup Winners' Cup]], followed by a second victory in [[1998 UEFA Cup Winners' Cup final|1998]]. They subsequently won the [[2012 UEFA Champions League final|UEFA Champions League]] in [[2012 UEFA Champions League final|2012]] and [[2021 UEFA Champions League final|2021]], and the [[UEFA Europa League]] in [[2013 UEFA Europa League final|2013]] and [[2019 UEFA Europa League final|2019]]. After winning the [[UEFA Conference League]] in [[2025 UEFA Conference League final|2025]], Chelsea became the first club to win [[UEFA club competition records and statistics#List of teams to have won the main European club competitions|all four main UEFA competitions]] as well as all UEFA men's competitions. They also won the [[FIFA Club World Cup]] in [[2021 FIFA Club World Cup final|2021]] and [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup final|2025]], the latter of which was the first iteration of the tournament with 32 teams.

Nicknamed ''the Blues'', the team adopted their distinctive royal blue home strip early in the club's history, moving away from their original light blue shirts. Also associated with the club is their traditional anthem, "[[Blue Is the Colour (song)|Blue Is the Colour]]". Chelsea contest the [[West London derby]] against local rivals [[Fulham F.C.|Fulham]], alongside fierce capital fixtures with [[Arsenal F.C.–Chelsea F.C. rivalry|Arsenal]] and [[Chelsea F.C.–Tottenham Hotspur F.C. rivalry|Tottenham Hotspur]]. As one of the most successful clubs in the country, they also share a prominent and [[Chelsea F.C.–Leeds United F.C. rivalry|long-standing rivalry]] with [[Leeds United F.C.|Leeds United]]."}}
